The three lies, and where each lived





  
LieMechanismFix

  

    a test that "runs" but never ran
    run_test "..." "bash tests/e2e/…" — the [[ -f ]]
        guard sees a filename starting with bash  → silent SKIP,
        every local run, forever. CI's glob was the only executor.
    bare path; file swept — last instance of the class
  

  

    failures that are not failures
    validators schema-checked gitignored live-session state
        (session/state.json, memory journals) that another process
        owns mid-write
    skip what git deliberately ignores (batched
        check-ignore --stdin); no git → validate everything
  

  

    work done twice, counted once
    CI job re-ran 2 .mjs tests explicitly after the glob —
        widened in #3228 — already ran them, under a comment describing the
        pre-#3228 runner
    explicit lines removed; comment now records the history
  







The 348 nobody counted




  before   sections print "Warnings: N" …22, 20, 13, 10, 8…
           nothing sums them → an unowned mass that reads as noise
           (this is where "more than 10 is much more" actually lived)

  after    run_test tees each section, sums the counts
           summary prints:  Advisory warnings: 348 (baseline 348)
           growth prints:   Advisory warnings: 353 (baseline 348) — GREW…
           still advisory — a hard gate on 348 pre-existing advisories
           would report a regression that did not happen



Ratchet direction. Down as sections get cleaned.
  Never raised to quiet the summary. Same contract as
  UNREACHABLE_BASELINE and the non-invocable docs ratchet.

  8 files reachable via two entrypoints → follows from #3235's decision
